verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical: a sensible left-to-right banner with logo, a large one-line headline, then the shoe in its lime circle at the right. Both share the same flaws. 'Full review inside.' is broken into a tiny three-line stack jammed beside the circle, the 'NEW VIDEO' pill is shrunk to near-illegible size and wedged under the logo, and the shoe circle is crushed against the right edge with very little margin.
